column1: Acme Corp is a Organization. A global software solutions company.
Sales is a Department. Handles all sales and client relations.
Customer Support is a Department. Provides technical and customer support.
Marketing is a Department. Responsible for advertising, campaigns, and lead generation.
IT Department is a Department. Manages infrastructure, security, and development.
Human Resources is a Department. Manages employee onboarding, payroll, and benefits.
Alice Johnson is a Person. Their role is Sales Manager. They belong to the Sales department.
Bob Lee is a Person. Their role is Support Engineer. They belong to the Customer Support department.
Clara Smith is a Person. Their role is Marketing Lead. They belong to the Marketing department.
David Kim is a Person. Their role is Software Engineer. They belong to the IT Department department.
Emily Brown is a Person. Their role is HR Specialist. They belong to the Human Resources department.
Salesforce is a Tool. Customer relationship management platform used for sales and client tracking.
Zoho Desk is a Tool. Helpdesk software used for managing customer tickets and support workflows.
Slack is a Tool. Collaboration and communication tool for team messaging and file sharing.
Jira is a Tool. Tool for issue tracking and agile project management.
GitHub is a Tool. Platform for version control and collaboration using Git.
Power BI is a Tool. Data visualization tool used for business intelligence and reporting.
Zendesk is a Tool. Customer service software for managing support tickets and interactions.
